apps.name: Dispatcher
apps.description: Schedule outbound pickups and inbound arrivals, track load progress, and view daily timelines.
apps.releaseNotes:
Dispatcher 1.1.1

Connects to the new MES server at https://mes.dhmsc.com.
Existing MES server settings move automatically. Custom server addresses are preserved.
Install over the existing app to retain saved settings and authorization. The package ID and signing certificate are unchanged.

apps.name: MES Store
apps.description: Your MES apps and updates, together in one place.
apps.releaseNotes:
MES Store 1.2.10

Distinct Featured cards for your workplace apps:
- Dispatcher has a charcoal-and-amber pickup timeline and truck illustration.
- Time Punch has a sage-and-green clock and employee punch illustration.
- SignPad keeps its signature artwork with updated messaging.
- MES Store is excluded from Featured and remains available under Apps.

- Dispatcher displays its actual launcher icon throughout the store, including before installation.
- The bottom navigation is more compact, leaving more room for app content.
- Download and installation buttons fill as progress bars and show measured percentages.
- Installation still requires Android confirmation, with cancellation, retry, and interrupted-session recovery.

Install over the existing MES Store to preserve settings and downloads. Android 9 or newer. The package ID and release signing key are unchanged.
